“Just the same, Francis boy, you’re going to marry this one. I know it. I feel it in my bones. I’d bet on it.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’ll bet you a thousand I don’t.”", "sha256": "6641d30ef6f9f735cc9287902a9e5739109ad92558f1a1ef2eb40b85d638add9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2698]", "source_html": "

“I’ll bet you a thousand I don’t.”

“Any amount you want.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“Done, then, for a thousand and fifty dollars.—Now go right into the office there and take a look at her.”", "sha256": "f07eec89a679899d74e0107ad873d377651dbb19d5893b0dd0cf0da492a46915", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2701]", "source_html": "

“Done, then, for a thousand and fifty dollars.—Now go right into the office there and take a look at her.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0057", "tag": "p", "text": "“She’s with Leoncia?”", "sha256": "b36148a5eef6af876fd68d158c8d306f372400ae383263787e0c93e75bdfca97", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2702]", "source_html": "

“She’s with Leoncia?”

“Nope; she’s by herself.”
